right.raw_text: 2. Patients with a history of drug abuse and / or alcohol abuse 2 years prior to the screening period

left.raw_text: 3. One or more of the laboratory findings fall out of the limitations for this study(platelet,hemoglobin,aspartate aminotransferase,etc.)

right.raw_text: 4. Pregnant women or those in lactation period
5. Allergic to drugs used in the study

left.raw_text: 6. Patients with respiratory management difficulties (Modified Mallampati grade IV)
7. Patients have participated in other clinical trial within the 3 months prior to randomization

right.raw_text: 8. Any patient judged by the Principal Investigator (PI) or Sub-Investigator to be inappropriate for the subject for any other reason
